title: Hakoniwa Robot Runtime sensor output
description: How measured values of named sensors are published. The sensors are defined separately (sensor-instances.schema.json). The Runtime checks at start-up that every name exists and that the sensor types fit the message type (sensor_msgs/JointState: joint sensors, one entry per sensor in the listed order; geometry_msgs/WrenchStamped: exactly one force-torque sensor; sensor_msgs/Imu: exactly one IMU; sensor_msgs/LaserScan: exactly one 2D LiDAR; sensor_msgs/PointCloud2: exactly one LiDAR, 2D or 3D; sensor_msgs/Range: exactly one rangefinder; sensor_msgs/MagneticField, FluidPressure, NavSatFix: exactly one magnetometer, barometer, GPS receiver; sensor_msgs/Image: exactly one depth camera, with its sensor_msgs/CameraInfo on camera_info_pdu_name; frame_id is the sensor name).

camera_info_pdu_name.description: sensor_msgs/Image only (required there): the channel of its sensor_msgs/CameraInfo.
